name: Beat the Beast: Kraken’s Lair
review:
The Beat the Beast series goes under the sea. It's a 9-line game with expanding wins, plus a bonus of free spins that can retrigger.

Very high volatility, 7,777x cap, 96.12% RTP. One of the more compact entries in the series, with not much going on in the base game. It's really about getting to the bonus.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
